decisions.reason: Turnaround management software is close to the core, has its own page and is central to the data-driven integration strategy, so this low-cost option stays open while its value keeps building.
The connectivity module is cheap to maintain as an add-on to the installed apron base, and airport sales cycles are long, so two years is not enough evidence to abandon it.
Billing software sits furthest from the operational core and still has low visibility, but keeping it costs little and its value in integrated airport suites is not yet resolved.
Equipment monitoring supports the growing service and maintenance business on the installed base, so the option remains valuable and cheap to hold.
Resource management complements turnaround software and could be merged into a bundle later, but for now holding it separately costs little while uncertainty remains.
The safety alert service builds on the tower and traffic control offer, where procurement by air navigation providers is slow, so more time is needed before its value can be judged.
